approved_decision.rule: Approve exactly 100 governed D01 concepts with A1=20 A2=20 B1=25 B2=35 and global indices 0001..0100; approval is semantic-reference authority only.

governance_decisions.decision: Accept PT and EN reference labels as semantic pivots subject to their recorded ambiguity/one-to-one flags; no external language selects HNK meaning or form.
Accept 83 Esperanto entries as HIGH_CONFIDENCE internal references without claiming item-by-item Akademio attestation; retain 17 entries explicitly PROVISIONAL pending later lexicographic validation.

Preserve six reviewed near-semantic clusters as distinct concepts unless a later explicit semantic change gate merges them: origin/birthplace~birthplace; nationality~citizenship; nickname~alias~pseudonym; name~name subtypes; address~street address~proof of address; identity document~document subtypes.
Accept the 19 existing-HNK mappings only as semantic cross-references; no HNK meaning authority, lifecycle, morphology, registration or credit changes.
Keep HNK3000 Wave05+ form generation paused. Semantic-master work may continue to Batch02 D02 after this review, while provisional Esperanto entries remain visibly flagged.
